summary: Persistent live runtime: 17-step loop with approvals, waiting, limits, crash-safe resume; structured logs with redaction; journal; task loader and three task files; independent membership / metric verifiers with signing, hash-chained log and service; operator control; multi-actor plumbing; dashboard; doctor; preflight; cam-live CLI; learner process entry. Built and tested against the AgentAPI protocol with a small real test agent, LabWorld, and the real authorization service and computer environment (in-process and under separated uids). The integrated neural agent, staging validation module and transfer evaluation module are not present yet.

AE-06.limitations: Exercised with two LabWorld actors and a small ridge learner; the integrated agent must implement export_experience / weights_version / set_weights (multi.ActorAgent) to take part. The RPC learner endpoint was exercised with an in-process server thread, not separate hosts.

CU-24.limitations: Evidence that arrives without a scheduled wake is only seen at the configured evidence poll interval (the environment contract has no push channel).

LX-01.limitations: 17 items are marked REQUIRED for the operator (limits, guild id, credential name, owned site, authorized tools and destinations, publishing authorization, evidence source, test accounts, currency, feedback permission, authorization record id).

LX-02.limitations: The scan covers task files and objective assignment. It is structural (rejected keys anywhere, enumerated or ordered instructions, directives to the agent, timing directives, suggested-solution phrasing) plus a five-word vocabulary; free prose that describes a strategy without any of these forms is not detected. It does not scan source code of other workstreams.

LX-03.limitations: The verifier logic, signing, hash-chained log and the service under its own uid are implemented and tested with in-memory and JSONL membership sources. No live Discord MembershipSource exists in F: a '<module>:<factory>' returning one for the authorized guild (workstream ES) must be named in success.evidence_source. Duplicate or artificial accounts are excluded only where the source marks them (link_key, flags); the verifier does not infer them. Never run against a real guild.

LX-07.limitations: ExperimentRecords come from the learner through the optional drain_experiments() hook, which is not part of contracts.AgentAPI (change request F-1). Until the integrated agent provides it, only the runtime-side experiment_outcome records are written. Tested with the small test agent.

LX-08.limitations: The runtime writes exactly the LearningUpdateRecord / MetaUpdateRecord objects returned by agent.learn / agent.meta_learn (fsync'ed); their content is the learner's responsibility.

LX-09.limitations: Derived mechanically; 'how the approach changed' is measured as the mix of chosen operations over time and as obstacle follow-ups, not as a semantic description of strategies. Regeneration re-reads the whole logs (throttled: every 200 cycles and at most every 600 clock seconds, plus at pause / finish / stop).

LX-10.limitations: Tested through the FastAPI test client; the uvicorn server path (dashboard.serve) was only checked for its loopback refusal, and the page's JavaScript was not exercised in a browser. Calibration shown is computed from logged predictions (error and 1/2-sigma coverage); the learner's own calibration tables are not shown unless it reports them.

LX-12.limitations: On this machine the report for tasks/discord_100.yaml is LIVE: BLOCKED with every missing item listed. The authorization-record and credential checks rely on PolicyService.limits_state() / secret_names() as they exist today; they were exercised against the running authorization service only for a staging task.

LX-13.limitations: A record holds the Decision as the learner produced it plus the runtime's situation digest; rationale and diagnostics are whatever the learner put in the Decision.

LX-14.limitations: Money and compute are accounted from ActionResult.cost and from the measured duration of learner calls; outside live mode a limit left at 0 is not enforced and is listed in the run_started record. The authorization service keeps its own, independent ledger.

LX-15.limitations: Driven by a small real test agent (tests/runtime/rt_lab_agent.py), not by the integrated neural agent, which does not exist yet. Kill tests use LabWorld served over the project RPC behind a de-duplicating host; in-flight recovery against the real exec service was not exercised. The write-ahead journal holds unredacted decisions and results until the next commit.

LX-16.limitations: Both modes ran as detached processes with the test agent: in-process (default suite) and separated uids through harness.auth.launcher (privileged test: learner uid camlearn, verifier camverify, executor cambrowser, authorization camauth, no browser). Not run with the integrated agent, the browser, or any live service. cam-live resume of a separated run (re-launch on an existing run directory) was not exercised.

CM-01.limitations: Persistent-storage detection reads the instance manifest (/etc/vast_capabilities.json); elsewhere it is reported as unknown. Model checks look at files in the local cache; nothing is loaded.

CM-02.limitations: Creates the state root, resolved configuration, dashboard token and the initial checkpoint through the agent factory. Verified with --agent-factory rt_lab_agent:build_agent only; the default factory cam_live.agent:build_agent is not present yet (the command then exits 4 and says so).

CM-03.limitations: Runs pytest per suite and writes docs/evidence/test_results/cli_<suite>.xml; marks are passed through with -m.

CM-04.limitations: Delegates to cam_live.validation.run_staging(cfg), which does not exist yet: the command exits 4 with that message. Only the dispatch, the refusal of non-staging modes and the missing-component path are tested.

CM-05.limitations: Tested on LabWorld (--lab); run by hand on the in-process computer environment (4 internal tools). It lists the executors the configuration registers: the visual, code, api, skill and Discord executors appear only once their factories are listed in runtime.executors (change request F-7).

CM-06.limitations: Refusals (unset live task, missing operator authorization record, live in-process, strategy content) and both start modes are tested with the test agent. A live start was never attempted. Registration of the live authorization record goes through AuthClient.register_live_authorization and was not exercised with a signed record.

CM-07.limitations: Reads the run directory; learning state is what the logs contain.

CM-08.limitations: Waits for the runtime's acknowledgement (checkpoint taken, status paused).

CM-09.limitations: Resumes a paused process, or restarts the process from state.json + checkpoint + write-ahead journal when none is alive (tested in-process mode after kill -9). Restart of a separated run was not exercised.

CM-10.limitations: Delegates to cam_live.eval.transfer.main(argv), which does not exist yet: exits 4. Only dispatch and argument checks are tested.

CM-11.limitations: With a running runtime the export is agent.save(dest) plus an export manifest; with no process it uses cam_live.credit.checkpoint.export_weights when the checkpoint has that format and otherwise copies the committed checkpoint (the manifest says which). Only the copy path was exercised (test agent checkpoints).

CM-12.limitations: Delegates to cam_live.verify_completion.main(argv) (master-owned). Checked by hand that the command dispatches (`cam-live verify-completion --help`); the checker itself was not run by F.

measured.overhead_command: cd /workspace/camlive && .venv/bin/python cam_live/docs/evidence/F/measure_loop.py  (300 decisions on LabWorld, test agent; docs/evidence/F/loop_overhead.json)

not_done: Nothing in F was run with the integrated neural agent (cam_live.agent does not exist yet): every loop, CLI and process test uses tests/runtime/rt_lab_agent.py.
No live Discord MembershipSource; the membership verifier has only been fed in-memory and JSONL evidence. No Discord API call was made.
cam-live validate and cam-live evaluate-transfer only delegate; their target modules (cam_live.validation, cam_live.eval.transfer) are absent, so both exit 4.
cam-live init with the default agent factory, and any GPU path of init, was not run.
Dashboard: not served under uvicorn in a test and its JavaScript was not run in a browser.

Separated mode: resume/restart of a separated run, approvals through the real authorization service, emergency stop through the launcher, and in-flight action recovery against the real exec service were not exercised. The browser executor was disabled in the separated test.
Registration and verification of a signed live authorization record through cam-live run was not exercised.
experiments.jsonl content and obstacle explanations depend on optional learner hooks that are not in contracts.AgentAPI (change request F-1).
The write-ahead journal (wal.jsonl, mode 0600) and state.json hold unredacted decisions/results of the uncommitted span; only the RunFiles logs are redacted.
The run-directory collision with the computer environment's events.jsonl (change request F-2) is worked around, not resolved.
